g.text: Pushbroom model: data rate = pixels across track x lines per second (ground speed 7.0 km/s / GSD) x bands x 12 bits, imaging 30 % of the time. Link capacity = rate x
daily contact time (assumed). Sentinel-2 check: the same model with its 10/20/60 m bands gives about 4.4 TB/day before compression. (b) Scene cloud fractions follow
a U-shaped beta distribution with a mean of 55 % (land); scenes more than 70 % cloudy are discarded.
